issues.title: Ingest Cleveland County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $6,925,466 across 30 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($2,519,186), County Road Department Fund ($2,298,444), Solid Waste Fund ($1,111,890). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
